name: Scroll Video Panels
description: Full-screen scroll story where each chapter wipes up over a hero, with a background photo, sliding video tiles, and big masked title lines, ending in a footer title section.
contents: Hero section with background image and large two-line title
Chapter panels, each with background image, three video tiles, big title with accent word and subtitle lines
Footer section with background image and large title
behavior: Each chapter is fixed and revealed by a scroll-scrubbed clip-path wipe from the bottom
Background image scales down and fades while video tiles slide in from alternating sides
Videos play only while the chapter is mostly in view and pause otherwise
Title and subtitle lines rise in with a staggered mask reveal and reverse when scrolling back
Reveal animation is skipped and videos stay paused with reduced motion preference
editableByProps: Number of chapters, images, video sources, title lines, accent word and subtitle lines
Hero and footer images and titles
Background, text and accent color classes
Display and body fonts, reveal duration, tile slide distance and image scale

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll length of each chapter
Change the timing of the wipe, tile slide and fade stages
needsCodeEdit.where: The gsap timeline with scrollTrigger inside the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the video tile count or layout

fixed: Chapter panels are position fixed and driven by invisible 300vh ghost spacers that give the scroll range
Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub on the page scroll, so the component should span the full page width
Videos are muted and only play inside the active scroll range
Accent word styling applies only to the first matching word per chapter
